questions.q: What were the priests offering that Malachi condemns?
questions.evidence: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil

questions.q: Whom does Yahweh send to prepare the way before him?
questions.evidence: Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me

questions.q: In what had the people robbed God, Malachi says?
questions.evidence: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings

questions.q: Whom will Yahweh send before his great and terrible day?
questions.evidence: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes
